svg.title: Optimize the signal you mean, not the one that is easiest to raise.

cc:Work.dc:title: Optimize the signal you mean, not the one that is easiest to raise.
cc:Work.dc:description: Tabular TD(0) · four-option exploration task over 10 seeds · best-of-n selection with 2,000 repeats per pressure level Seeded computational demonstrations, not neural recordings or a deployed-model evaluation. Shaded bands: min–max across seeds. Belief change is the KL divergence between successive predictive distributions; learning progress is the change in windowed surprise.
